decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's publicly presented flagship and has won the gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut repeatedly, so heavy visible commitment and positive results make dropping it very unlikely.

Unlike the other new breads that were removed in 2024, the dark barley malt rye bread kept its own page for two years, so it survived the firm's pruning of the bread range and has little reason to be dropped now, although its modest public commitment leaves it more exposed than the stollen.

The marzipan stollen sits within the firm's prominent and award-winning seasonal stollen line and has been shown on its own page for both years, so dropping it would undercut the stollen focus the firm has committed to.
